title: Tidal Line Sterling Silver Necklace
description: A fine sterling silver chain carries a small, softly irregular wave-shaped pendant, polished on the front and left lightly textured along the edge. The pendant measures 14 mm across, and the adjustable chain fastens at 16 or 18 inches. Wear it on its own for a subtle detail or layer it with shorter chains. Made in small batches from recycled 925 sterling silver and finished with a spring ring clasp.

title: Citrine Sunburst Stud Earrings
description: Warm golden citrine sits at the center of these petite sunburst studs, framed by hand-shaped rays in gold vermeil over sterling silver. Each round stone measures approximately 4 mm, with a total earring diameter of 9 mm. Secure butterfly backs keep the lightweight pair comfortable through a full day of wear. Natural citrine varies slightly in tone, so each set has its own honey-colored character. Sold as a pair.

title: Moss Agate Signet Ring
description: A deep green moss agate cabochon gives this sterling silver signet ring a grounded, organic look. The oval stone measures 8 by 10 mm and is set in a low bezel with a softly brushed band. Natural inclusions make every stone pattern distinct. Choose from US sizes 5 through 9; the substantial band is designed to sit comfortably on the little or ring finger. Wipe dry after wearing and store away from moisture.

title: Pebble Chain Bracelet
description: Small, irregular sterling silver links give this bracelet the feel of smooth pebbles gathered along a shoreline. The 6.5-inch chain includes a 1-inch extender for an adjustable fit, finished with a lobster clasp and a stamped studio tag. Its gentle shine works alone or alongside a watch without feeling heavy. Each link is formed and joined by hand in small batches, so the contours have subtle variations.

title: Tiny Crescent Moon Charm
description: This petite crescent moon charm is cast in solid 14k yellow gold and finished with a small soldered jump ring. Measuring 8 mm from tip to tip, it adds a quiet celestial detail to a fine chain, charm bracelet, or existing charm hoop. The simple, polished shape is designed for everyday wear and layers easily with other small pendants. Chain is not included.

title: Initial Disc Necklace, Hand-Stamped
description: Make a necklace personal with a hand-stamped initial on a small sterling silver disc. The 12 mm pendant hangs from an adjustable 16- to 18-inch sterling silver cable chain and is finished with a secure spring ring clasp. Select one uppercase letter at checkout; the slightly varied impression is part of the hand-stamped finish. A thoughtful everyday piece for marking a name, memory, or meaningful initial. Please allow extra time for personalization.

title: Lidded Travel Jewelry Case in Sage
description: Keep a small jewelry rotation organized in this compact, sage-green travel case. The exterior is covered in textured vegan leather, while the soft microfiber lining helps protect delicate finishes. Inside are a ring roll, a divided compartment for earrings and small pendants, and a removable pouch for chains. Measuring 4 by 4 by 2 inches, it slips easily into a weekender bag or desk drawer. A snap closure keeps the contents in place.

title: Hammered Gold Vermeil Hoop Earrings
description: These medium hoops pair a clean circular silhouette with a hand-hammered surface that catches the light without a high polish. Each hoop is made from sterling silver and finished in a thick layer of 14k gold vermeil. They measure 22 mm in diameter and close with a hinged latch post for easy on-and-off wear. The lightly textured finish makes them a versatile choice with casual layers or a simple evening outfit. Sold as a pair.

title: Recycled Silver Ring Sizer Set
description: Find a more reliable ring size at home with this reusable set of smooth plastic ring gauges. The set includes US sizes 1 through 13 in half-size increments, connected on a metal ring for easy storage. Slide a gauge onto the finger where you plan to wear your ring and check that it passes over the knuckle comfortably without spinning. This practical sizing tool is especially useful before ordering a made-to-size band. It is a fitting aid, not jewelry.

title: Brushed Solid Gold Ridge Band
description: A narrow ridge runs around this solid 14k yellow gold band, adding texture to a simple, understated silhouette. The 2 mm band has a brushed finish that softens the shine and pairs easily with a solitaire or other slim rings. Made for daily wear, it can be worn alone as a minimal band or stacked with mixed metals. Available in US sizes 4 through 10 in whole and half sizes; select your size before adding to cart.

title: North Star Labradorite Necklace
description: A deep blue-gray labradorite cabochon hangs from a fine sterling silver cable chain, catching subtle flashes of color as it moves. The oval stone is set in a low-profile bezel with a polished finish, making this an easy piece to wear on its own or layer with shorter chains. Choose a 16-inch or 18-inch chain; each necklace is assembled in small batches and fastens with a spring ring clasp.

title: Wildflower Gold Vermeil Threader Earrings
description: Delicate five-petal flower forms give these threader earrings a light, botanical feel. Each pair is made from sterling silver with a thick layer of 18-karat gold vermeil, with slim chains that pass through the piercing and hang comfortably below the lobe. The flowers measure about 9 mm across, and the total drop is approximately 2 inches. Wear them with a simple blouse or let them add movement to an evening look.

title: Open Tidepool Cuff Ring
description: Inspired by rippled water and worn sea glass, this open cuff ring has an irregular, softly textured surface rather than a high-shine polish. It is cast in recycled sterling silver and finished by hand, with gently rounded ends designed for comfortable everyday wear. The open design allows for slight adjustment, while the band measures about 4 mm wide. Wear it alone as a sculptural accent or pair it with a slim stacking ring.

title: Garnet Bead and Silver Bracelet
description: Small faceted garnet beads bring a warm, wine-red accent to this fine bracelet. The stones are hand-strung with sterling silver spacer beads and finished with a secure lobster clasp and a short extender chain. Choose a 6.5-inch or 7.5-inch length for a closer or more relaxed fit. It looks lovely worn alone, but its delicate scale also makes it easy to stack with a silver chain bracelet or watch.

title: Mini Labradorite Drop Charm
description: A petite labradorite teardrop adds shifting blue and green flashes to a favorite chain or bracelet. The 8 mm stone is set in a simple sterling silver bezel, with a small hinged bail that fits most fine chains and charm bracelets. Natural stones vary slightly in color and pattern, so each charm has its own character. Wear it as a subtle everyday detail or combine it with other small gemstone charms.

title: Engraved Coordinates Bar Necklace
description: Mark a meaningful place with a slim sterling silver bar engraved with its coordinates. The gently rounded bar measures 28 mm and hangs from a fine cable chain with a spring ring clasp. Enter one set of latitude and longitude at checkout; engraving is done in a clean, compact typeface on the front. Available with a 16-inch or 18-inch chain, this understated necklace makes a thoughtful keepsake for a home, favorite trail, or special meeting place.

title: Cedarwood Roll-Top Jewelry Box
description: Keep everyday pieces organized in this compact jewelry box made from solid cedarwood with a smooth, natural finish. A roll-top lid opens to reveal a soft-lined interior with a ring groove and two open sections for earrings, chains, or small keepsakes. The box measures 6 by 4 by 2.5 inches, making it suitable for a dresser or bedside table. Its warm wood grain varies naturally from piece to piece.

title: Tiny Pearl and Gold Filled Huggie Earrings
description: These petite huggie earrings pair a simple gold-filled hoop with a small freshwater pearl drop. The hinged hoops are easy to fasten and sit close to the lobe, while the removable pearls add a soft touch of luster without feeling overly formal. Each hoop measures about 10 mm in diameter, and the earrings are sold as a pair. Wear them with the pearls attached or use the hoops on their own for a pared-back look.

title: Solid Gold Dune Stacking Ring
description: A low, softly undulating ridge gives this narrow band the look of wind-shaped sand. Hand-finished in solid 14-karat yellow gold, it is comfortable enough for daily wear and pairs easily with plain or gemstone rings. The band is approximately 1.7 mm wide, with a gently rounded interior. Available in US sizes 5 through 9; select your size before ordering. Its subtle texture adds interest without competing with other pieces.

title: Twisted Sterling Silver Rope Bracelet
description: Two slender strands of sterling silver are twisted together to create a rope-like bracelet with a soft, reflective finish. The flexible chain is finished with a lobster clasp and a 1-inch extender, so it can be adjusted for a comfortable fit. Choose a 6.5-inch or 7.5-inch base length. Wear it as a neat standalone accent or stack it with a smooth bangle for a mix of textures.

title: Fold-Flat Velvet Jewelry Organizer
description: This fold-flat travel organizer keeps small jewelry pieces separated in a suitcase or overnight bag. The exterior is made from durable cotton velvet, while the zippered interior has a ring roll, an earring panel, and two pockets for necklaces or bracelets. Measuring 8 by 5 inches when closed, it opens fully for easy access and packs down neatly when empty. Available in dusty rose or midnight blue, each organizer closes with a smooth metal zipper.

title: Rainfall Bar Pendant Necklace
description: A slender sterling silver pendant catches the light with a softly irregular, rain-textured finish. The 18-inch cable chain includes a two-inch extender for adjusting the drop over a crew neck or open collar. The pendant measures 28 mm long and is made in small batches, so its hand-finished surface varies slightly from piece to piece. Wear it alone for a clean everyday accent or layer it with a shorter chain.

title: Sea Glass Gold Vermeil Ear Climbers
description: A pair of gold vermeil ear climbers follows the curve of the lobe with a row of small, softly rounded beads. Each earring has a sterling silver base finished in 18k gold vermeil and a straight post with a butterfly back. The sculpted profile adds a little shine without the weight of a long drop. Sold as a pair, these are designed for pierced ears and work well with simple studs in a second piercing.

title: Black Spinel Arc Ring
description: A slim sterling silver band curves around a single black spinel set in a low-profile bezel. The polished stone measures approximately 3 mm across, giving the ring a subtle dark glint that suits everyday wear. Its gently open silhouette leaves a small gap at the back and allows a little flexibility, though it should not be repeatedly bent to change size. Choose from three size options for a comfortable fit.

title: Woven Link Bracelet in Solid Gold
description: Fine solid gold links form a supple woven chain that rests lightly at the wrist. Made in 14k gold, the bracelet measures 6.5 inches and comes with a one-inch extender and a small spring-ring clasp. Its understated shine makes it easy to wear on its own or alongside a watch. The delicate links are best kept away from heavy pulling and stored flat when not in use.

title: Tiny Oyster Shell Charm
description: A miniature oyster shell charm is cast in sterling silver, with fine ridges picked out in a softly polished finish. Measuring about 12 mm high, it has a small attached loop sized to fit most fine chains and charm bracelets. Add it to a necklace as a seaside keepsake or pair it with other small pendants for a collected look. Chain is sold separately, making it easy to style with jewelry you already own.

title: Handwriting Keepsake Pendant
description: Turn a few meaningful words into a small sterling silver pendant engraved from a supplied handwriting sample. The round disc measures 16 mm across and comes with a 16-inch chain plus a two-inch extender. Upload a clear photo or scan of the writing when ordering; short names or phrases work best for legibility. Each pendant is finished by hand, and the original character of the handwriting is retained rather than converted to a standard font.

title: Maple Leaf Jewelry Dish
description: Keep daily-wear pieces in one easy-to-find spot with this shallow ceramic dish shaped like a maple leaf. A glossy ivory glaze covers the hand-pressed surface, while the gently raised edges help keep rings and small earrings from slipping off a nightstand. It measures approximately 5 by 4 inches and is intended for tabletop storage, not travel. Use it beside the sink or on a dresser for jewelry you reach for often.

title: Blue Topaz Threaded Bar Necklace
description: A bezel-set blue topaz sits at the center of a fine sterling silver bar pendant, adding a clear flash of color to a clean, linear design. The pendant is 24 mm long and hangs from an 18-inch chain with a two-inch extender. A secure lobster clasp makes it simple to adjust the length for different necklines. Wear it as a focused pop of color or layer it with shorter silver chains for a more relaxed look.

title: Sculpted Pebble Stud Earrings
description: These small sterling silver studs take their rounded shape from smooth river pebbles, with a softly domed face and satin-brushed finish. Each stud measures about 8 mm across and sits close to the ear for comfortable daily wear. Sterling silver posts and butterfly backs are included. Their simple form pairs easily with other earrings or makes a quiet standalone accent, and the pair arrives ready to wear in a compact cotton-lined box.

title: Personalized Birthstone Signet Ring
description: A small oval signet face holds a choice of lab-created birthstone in a solid 14k gold setting. Personalize the ring by selecting a month stone and one of five available sizes; the smooth face is left unengraved to keep the colored stone in focus. The low setting is designed for comfortable everyday wear, while the narrow band keeps the silhouette delicate. Please remove the ring before swimming, cleaning, or handling abrasive materials.

title: Linen-Wrapped Jewelry Box with Ring Roll
description: A compact, structured jewelry box keeps small favorites organized at home or tucked into a weekender. The exterior is wrapped in natural linen, with a zip-around closure and a soft microfiber lining inside. A removable ring roll holds several rings, while the divided tray has room for earrings, chains, and a few small pendants. Measuring 6 by 4 by 2 inches, it fits neatly in a drawer or on a bedside table.

title: Moonlit Kelp Sterling Silver Pendant Necklace
description: A slender sterling silver chain carries a small kelp-inspired pendant with softly etched fronds, capturing the quiet movement of sea plants. The pendant measures 18 mm long, and the adjustable chain fastens at 16 or 18 inches for easy layering. Made in small batches from recycled sterling silver, it has a polished front and a lightly textured reverse. Wear it on its own with an open neckline or pair it with shorter chains for a coastal-inspired stack.

title: Honeycomb Gold Vermeil Huggie Earrings
description: These compact huggie hoops feature an open honeycomb pattern cut into a gently rounded silhouette. Each pair is made from sterling silver with a thick layer of 18k gold vermeil, giving the geometric design a warm, polished finish. The hoops measure 13 mm across and close with hinged posts for a secure everyday fit. Lightweight enough for all-day wear, they bring a subtle pattern to simple outfits and pair neatly with studs in additional piercings.

title: Smoky Quartz Bezel Ring in Sterling Silver
description: A faceted smoky quartz sits in a smooth sterling silver bezel on this understated ring. The oval stone measures approximately 7 by 5 mm, with its translucent brown tones shifting gently in natural light. A slim, rounded band keeps the setting comfortable for daily wear and easy to pair with other rings. Each stone has its own subtle variations in color and inclusions. Available in US sizes 5 through 9, it makes a thoughtful choice for anyone drawn to earthy gemstones.

title: Sculpted Mariner Link Bracelet
description: Rounded sterling silver links give this mariner-style bracelet a clean, sculptural look without feeling heavy on the wrist. It measures 7 inches long and includes a 1-inch extender, finished with a spring ring clasp for an adjustable fit. The links are polished by hand in small batches, leaving a bright surface that works well with both casual layers and a simple watch. Wear it solo for a subtle statement or combine it with fine chain bracelets.

title: Tiny Starfish Gold Vermeil Charm
description: A tiny five-armed starfish charm brings a little shoreline detail to a favorite chain or bracelet. Cast in sterling silver and finished with 18k gold vermeil, it has softly raised texture across the arms and a smooth reverse. The charm measures about 12 mm from tip to tip and comes with a small attached loop sized for most fine chains. Add it to an existing charm collection, or pair it with a birthstone for a personal everyday keepsake.

title: Custom Zodiac Constellation Pendant
description: Choose a zodiac sign and we will set its constellation into a round sterling silver pendant, using small darkened stars connected by fine engraved lines. The pendant is 16 mm wide and arrives on an adjustable 16–18-inch sterling silver chain. Select from all twelve signs at checkout; the reverse can be left plain or engraved with up to eight characters. Made to order in small batches, this piece is an easy-to-wear reminder of a birthday, milestone, or favorite celestial symbol.

title: Compact Walnut Jewelry Box with Brass Latch
description: Keep everyday jewelry organized in this compact box made from solid walnut with a natural oil finish. Measuring 6 by 4 by 2.5 inches, it has a brass latch, a lift-out tray for rings and small studs, and an open compartment below for chains or bracelets. The interior is lined in soft charcoal cotton to help protect polished surfaces from scratches. Its small footprint fits easily on a bedside table, dresser, or desk, while the wood grain makes each box subtly unique.

title: Daisy Chain Silver and Pearl Necklace
description: Small sterling silver daisies alternate with freshwater seed pearls along this delicate necklace. The 16-inch chain includes a 2-inch extender, so it can sit close to the collarbone or hang slightly lower for layering. Each pearl is naturally shaped, making tiny differences part of the design, while the silver flowers add a bright, playful detail. A lobster clasp keeps the necklace secure. Wear it with a simple tee for an easy everyday accent or save it for spring celebrations and thoughtful gifting.

title: Solid Gold Threaded Ball Stud Earrings
description: These petite studs are made from solid 14k yellow gold, with smooth 3 mm ball fronts and threaded backs that screw on for a close, secure fit. Their low-profile shape is comfortable for everyday wear and works well in first or additional piercings. Each pair is produced in small batches and finished with a soft polish. The earrings arrive together in a cotton pouch, ready to wear or give as a simple gold staple that pairs easily with hoops and other studs.

title: Two-Tone Ridge Cuff Bracelet
description: A narrow ridge runs along the center of this open cuff, catching light between its contrasting finishes. The bracelet combines polished sterling silver with a small 18k gold vermeil accent on one end, creating a two-tone look that pairs naturally with mixed-metal jewelry. It measures 5.5 inches around with a 1-inch opening and can be gently adjusted for fit. The smooth inner surface makes it comfortable against the wrist. Wear it alone or stack it beside a watch or fine chain bracelet.

title: Pebble-Print Velvet Ring Box
description: This small ring box pairs a soft velvet exterior with a removable insert designed to hold six rings. Its pebble-print fabric has a muted, irregular pattern, while the hinged lid closes with a discreet snap to keep pieces neatly contained. Measuring 4 by 3 by 2 inches, it fits comfortably in a drawer or suitcase and can also sit on a dressing table. The insert lifts out to create room for earrings or small keepsakes when ring storage is not needed.

title: Satin-Finish Silver Lariat Necklace
description: A fine sterling silver chain ends in two slim, softly tapered drops for an easy lariat silhouette. The 18-inch chain has a 2-inch extender, so it can sit close to the collarbone or layer over a longer pendant. Each piece is assembled in small batches and finished with a spring-ring clasp. Wear it with an open neckline or over a simple knit; the understated shape works for everyday styling without competing with other jewelry.

title: Cobalt Glass and Silver Drop Earrings
description: Deep cobalt glass beads bring a bright pop of color to these lightweight sterling silver drop earrings. Each smooth bead measures about 8 mm and hangs from a simple silver hook, giving the pair an overall drop of approximately 1.25 inches. The glass catches the light without feeling formal, making these an easy choice for daytime outfits or a dinner out. Each pair is assembled by hand in small batches and arrives with silicone backs for extra security.

title: Forged Silver Knot Ring
description: A softly irregular knot gives this sterling silver ring its sculptural shape, with gently forged contours that catch the light from every angle. The band is approximately 2 mm wide and has a polished finish, while the raised knot adds texture without feeling bulky. Available in US sizes 5 through 9, it makes a distinctive standalone ring or pairs comfortably with a slim stacking band. Each ring is made in small batches, so subtle variations are part of its character.

title: Olive Green Cord and Silver Bracelet
description: This adjustable bracelet pairs a durable olive green nylon cord with a small sterling silver tube bead for a relaxed, low-profile look. Sliding knots let you adjust the fit from approximately 6 to 9 inches, making it easy to put on and take off without a clasp. The cord is comfortable for daily wear, while the silver detail adds a subtle glint. Wear it alone or alongside metal bangles, and remove it before swimming or applying lotions to keep the materials looking their best.

title: Tiny Espresso Cup Silver Charm
description: A miniature espresso cup, cast in sterling silver, makes a playful charm for coffee lovers and collectors of small everyday objects. The cup measures about 12 mm tall and includes a fixed loop sized to fit most charm bracelets and fine chains. Its polished exterior contrasts with a darkened detail inside the cup for a little added depth. Attach it to a bracelet, necklace, or zipper pull for a personal touch; chain and bracelet are sold separately.

title: Custom Typewriter-Style Nameplate Necklace
description: Make a simple everyday necklace personal with a sterling silver nameplate stamped in a crisp, typewriter-inspired font. Choose a name or word up to 10 characters, and select an 18- or 20-inch chain when ordering. The slim plate measures approximately 30 by 6 mm and hangs horizontally from a delicate cable chain with a spring-ring clasp. Each piece is stamped to order, so spacing may vary slightly. Please enter your preferred text at checkout and allow extra time for personalization.

title: Slim Brass and Velvet Jewelry Box
description: Keep daily favorites together in this compact jewelry box, upholstered in charcoal cotton velvet with a warm brass-tone clasp. Inside, a removable ring roll and two small compartments help separate rings, studs, and delicate chains. The box measures 5 by 4 by 2 inches, making it a practical fit for a dresser or bedside table without taking up much space. A soft lining helps protect finished jewelry from scratches; this box is intended for home storage rather than travel.

title: Replacement Silver Polishing Cloth
description: Refresh your jewelry-care kit with a replacement two-layer polishing cloth for sterling silver pieces. The 3 by 3 inch cloth has a treated inner layer for lifting tarnish and a soft outer layer for buffing away fingerprints. Use it dry with gentle strokes, avoiding plated finishes, gemstones, and pearls unless their care instructions allow polishing cloths. This is a practical supply item rather than a keepsake gift, and it arrives folded in a recyclable paper sleeve.

title: Miniature Enamel Lemon Stud Earrings
description: Bright lemon-yellow enamel gives these tiny sterling silver studs a cheerful, graphic finish. Each lemon measures approximately 7 mm across and is secured with a straight post and butterfly back. The low-profile shape sits close to the ear, making the pair comfortable for everyday wear and easy to combine with other small studs. Enamel is applied in small batches, so minor differences in color and coverage may occur. Store the earrings separately and avoid harsh cleaners to preserve the glossy surface.

title: Wide Gold Vermeil Crescent Cuff
description: A broad crescent-shaped front gives this gold vermeil cuff a clean, architectural profile. The bracelet is made from sterling silver with a thick layer of 14k gold vermeil and has a smooth, softly rounded interior for comfortable wear. It measures about 6 inches around with a 1-inch opening and can be gently adjusted once for fit; repeated bending is not recommended. The open cuff slips over the wrist and looks striking on its own or alongside a slim chain bracelet.

title: Brushed Solid Gold Ear Cuff Pair
description: These petite ear cuffs are crafted in solid 14k gold with a softly brushed finish that adds a muted glow. Each cuff is approximately 8 mm wide and designed to slide onto the outer edge of the ear without a piercing; gently squeeze for a secure fit after positioning. Sold as a pair, they can be worn together on one ear or split between both ears. Their simple curved shape layers neatly with studs and hoops, making them a versatile fine-jewelry accent.

title: Sea Cliff Bead and Chain Necklace
description: A fine sterling silver chain meets three hand-cut blue chalcedony beads, arranged like a small stretch of coastline. The necklace measures 18 inches and fastens with a spring ring clasp, with a 2-inch extender for adjusting the drop. Each stone has subtle natural variation in color and translucency. Wear it alone with an open neckline or layer it with a shorter silver chain. Made in small batches and finished by hand.

title: Petal Disc Gold Vermeil Earrings
description: Lightweight drops with softly folded petal shapes, formed from recycled sterling silver and finished in warm 18k gold vermeil. Each pair hangs just under an inch from simple sterling silver ear wires and moves gently as you wear them. The satin finish keeps the surface understated, while the uneven edges give each pair a hand-shaped character. A cheerful choice for everyday outfits or a small gift for someone who loves botanical details.

title: Black Onyx Crescent Cocktail Ring
description: A smooth oval of black onyx sits in a low-profile sterling silver setting with a slim crescent-shaped shoulder on either side. The stone measures approximately 10 by 8 mm, providing a polished focal point without feeling bulky. A lightly brushed finish on the band contrasts with the glossy onyx. Available in US sizes 5 through 9, this small-batch ring pairs easily with plain silver bands and works well for day or evening wear.

title: Fine Cable Chain Bracelet with Gold Bead
description: A delicate sterling silver cable chain is accented with a single solid 14k gold bead, creating a subtle two-tone detail at the center of the wrist. The bracelet is 6.5 inches long with a 1-inch extender and a secure lobster clasp. Its fine scale makes it comfortable for daily wear and easy to stack with a watch or other chains. The bead is fixed in place so it stays centered as you move.

title: Tiny Moth Sterling Silver Charm
description: This petite moth charm is cast in recycled sterling silver with fine lines defining its wings and body. Measuring about 12 mm across, it has a small soldered jump ring that fits most standard charm bracelets and fine chains. The softly oxidized details bring out the shape while leaving the raised surfaces bright. Wear it as a quiet nature-inspired accent or add it to a charm collection alongside meaningful keepsakes.

title: Hand-Stamped Initial Cuff Bracelet
description: A narrow sterling silver cuff is hand-stamped with one initial of your choice in a clean uppercase typeface. The open-ended design is gently adjustable and sized to fit most adult wrists; the band measures 4 mm wide and has softly rounded edges for comfort. Choose a letter at checkout, and each piece will show slight variations from the hand-stamping process. A personal everyday keepsake that can be worn on its own or layered with slim bracelets.

title: Indigo Linen Travel Jewelry Roll
description: Keep small favorites organized in this compact jewelry roll, sewn from indigo linen with a soft cotton lining. It measures 8 by 5 inches when closed and unrolls to reveal a zip pocket, a ring bar, and three snap loops for necklaces or bracelets. A fabric tie secures the roll for packing, while the cushioned construction helps protect delicate pieces in a suitcase or drawer. Designed for travel and tidy everyday storage.

title: Miniature Moonstone Bar Necklace
description: A tiny rainbow moonstone cabochon is set into a slender 14k solid gold bar pendant, creating a restrained flash of color at the neckline. The pendant is suspended from a 16-inch gold chain with a 2-inch extender and a spring ring clasp. The smooth bezel protects the stone while keeping its softly rounded surface visible. Each moonstone has its own subtle internal sheen, making this a delicate piece for everyday wear or thoughtful layering.

title: Folded Ribbon Gold Vermeil Ear Cuffs
description: These sculptural ear cuffs curve around the outer ear in a folded ribbon shape, with no piercing required. Made from sterling silver and plated in 18k gold vermeil, each cuff measures about 14 mm tall and has a smooth, rounded interior edge. Gently squeeze the opening for a closer fit, then slide it onto the thinnest part of the ear and position it comfortably. Sold as a pair for a coordinated look or styled one at a time.

title: Tiny Paw Print Keepsake Pendant
description: Made to celebrate a beloved companion, this small sterling silver pendant features a paw print and a hand-stamped name on the reverse. The round disc measures 16 mm across and hangs from a 18-inch sterling silver cable chain with a 2-inch extender. Enter a name of up to eight letters when ordering; each piece is stamped by hand, so spacing may vary slightly. A meaningful daily keepsake for pet lovers, presented ready to give.

title: Recycled Silver Twist Stack Ring
description: Two slim strands of recycled sterling silver twist together to form a comfortable stacking ring with a subtle rope-like texture. The band is approximately 2 mm wide and polished by hand to catch the light without feeling flashy. Choose from US sizes 4 through 10; the closed band is best ordered in your usual ring size. Wear it alone for a delicate accent or combine it with smooth bands for an easy, mixed-texture stack.

title: Tidepool Glass Drop Necklace
description: A slender sterling silver chain carries a hand-shaped sea-glass drop in soft aqua, each piece naturally varied in color and edge. The pendant measures approximately 18 mm and hangs from an adjustable 16–18 inch chain with a spring ring clasp. Wear it alone for a quiet touch of color or layer it with shorter silver chains. Choose from pale aqua or deep teal glass; the recycled glass is polished smooth while retaining its individual character.

title: Little Fern Gold Vermeil Studs
description: These petite fern-shaped studs bring a botanical detail to everyday outfits without feeling precious. Each pair is cast in sterling silver and finished with a substantial layer of 14k gold vermeil, with softly raised leaf veins for a tactile finish. The earrings measure about 10 mm tall and secure with sterling silver posts and butterfly backs. Lightweight enough for all-day wear, they also make an easy gift for gardeners and nature lovers.

title: Raw Aquamarine Stack Ring
description: A small raw aquamarine sits in a simple four-prong sterling silver setting, showing the stone’s natural inclusions and pale blue-green tone. The narrow, lightly hammered band is designed to stack comfortably beside a plain band or wear on its own. Each stone is approximately 4–6 mm, so shape and color vary slightly from ring to ring. Available in US sizes 5 through 9; remove before swimming or applying lotions to help protect the finish.

title: Golden Hour Paperclip Bracelet
description: A fine paperclip-link bracelet in 14k gold vermeil adds a clean, modern accent to a watch or a stack of delicate chains. Made with a sterling silver base, it fastens with a lobster clasp and includes a 1-inch extender for a closer or looser fit. The bracelet measures 6.5 inches before the extender, and the elongated links have a polished finish. Store it dry between wears to help maintain the warm gold surface.

title: Tiny Fig Sterling Silver Charm
description: A miniature fig charm with a gently textured surface brings a small garden-inspired detail to a necklace or bracelet. Cast in solid sterling silver, it measures approximately 12 mm from top to bottom and comes with an attached, hinged jump ring that fits most fine chains. The reverse is smooth and lightly polished. Wear it on its own or combine it with other fruit and botanical charms to build a personal collection.

title: Custom Pet Nose Print Pendant
description: Turn a pet’s nose print into a small sterling silver keepsake pendant. Send a clear, high-contrast photo of the nose after ordering, and we’ll engrave the print onto a 16 mm round disc, then polish the front and leave the reverse smooth. The pendant arrives on an adjustable 16–18 inch silver chain with a spring ring clasp. Each piece is made to order, making it a meaningful everyday reminder of a beloved companion.

title: Juniper Velvet Jewelry Box
description: Keep small favorites organized in this compact jewelry box, wrapped in deep juniper-green cotton velvet with a soft cream lining. Inside, a removable ring roll sits beside two divided compartments for studs, chains, or delicate bracelets. The box measures 5 by 4 by 2 inches and closes with a discreet metal snap. It fits neatly on a dresser or in a suitcase and is designed for everyday storage rather than long-term tarnish protection.

title: Solid Gold Raindrop Pendant Necklace
description: A petite raindrop pendant in 14k solid gold offers a subtle polished glint on a fine matching chain. The drop measures 9 mm and has a softly rounded profile that catches light without sharp edges. Choose an 16- or 18-inch chain, each finished with a spring ring clasp and a small maker’s tag. Wear it as a minimal solo necklace or pair it with a longer pendant for an easy layered look.

title: Sculpted Arch Ear Jackets
description: These sterling silver ear jackets frame the earlobe with a pair of softly curved arches, adding dimension to a simple stud. Each set includes two sculpted jackets and small ball studs with sterling silver posts and butterfly backs. The jackets measure approximately 14 mm tall and can be worn with the supplied studs or paired with compatible small studs you already own. A brushed finish keeps the shape understated and easy to wear from day to evening.

title: Custom Roman Numeral Date Cuff
description: Mark a meaningful date on a slim cuff engraved with Roman numerals. Choose sterling silver or 14k gold vermeil, then provide a date and preferred engraving placement at checkout. The open cuff is gently adjustable and measures approximately 5.5 inches around, with a small gap for comfortable fitting. Its softly rounded edges sit smoothly against the wrist, making it suitable for daily wear or a personal anniversary gift. Please allow extra production time for custom engraving.

title: Moonstone Orbit Bangle
description: A slender sterling silver bangle circles the wrist with a small bezel-set rainbow moonstone at its front. The stone measures about 5 mm and shows a cool blue flash that shifts with the light. The hinged bangle has a secure side clasp and a 2.5-inch inner diameter, suited to a small or medium wrist. Wear it as a single delicate accent or mix it with smooth metal bangles for a layered stack.

title: Pine Needle Gold Vermeil Pendant Necklace
description: A slender sterling silver chain carries a small, hand-textured pine needle pendant, finished in warm 14k gold vermeil. The pendant measures about 22 mm long, and the adjustable 16–18 inch chain lets it sit neatly at the collarbone. Wear it alone with an open neckline or layer it with a shorter, simple chain. Each pendant is finished in small batches, so the fine surface marks vary slightly from piece to piece. A thoughtful choice for forest walks, nature lovers, and everyday layering.

title: Freshwater Pearl Swing Earrings
description: These lightweight drop earrings pair petite freshwater pearls with hand-formed sterling silver hooks. Each pearl is naturally shaped, giving the pair subtle differences in size and surface that make every set feel individual. They hang approximately 32 mm from the ear and move gently without feeling heavy. The polished silver provides a clean contrast to the soft pearl sheen, making them easy to wear with a crisp shirt or a simple evening dress. Sold as a pair; secure backs are included.

title: Faceted Smoky Quartz Stacking Ring
description: A petite faceted smoky quartz sits in a low-profile sterling silver setting, designed for comfortable daily wear and easy stacking. The stone measures approximately 5 mm across, with a slim 1.5 mm band that keeps the silhouette understated. Each quartz has its own natural tonal variation, ranging from pale tea to deep brown. Wear it on its own as a subtle accent or pair it with plain silver bands. Available in US sizes 5 through 9; select your size at checkout.

title: Sunbeam Solid Gold Chain Bracelet
description: This fine bracelet is made from solid 14k gold cable chain, finished with a small polished bead that catches the light as you move. A spring-ring clasp and two-inch extender make it adjustable for a comfortable fit. The delicate chain measures 1.2 mm wide and is suited to wearing alone or alongside a watch and other slim bracelets. Choose a 6.5–7.5 inch or 7.5–8.5 inch adjustable length. Made for everyday use, it has a quiet, uncomplicated look that works across seasons.

title: Tiny Fig Leaf Gold Vermeil Charm
description: A miniature fig leaf charm, cast in sterling silver and finished with a layer of 14k gold vermeil, brings a botanical detail to a favorite chain or bracelet. The leaf measures approximately 12 mm long and has lightly raised veins for a little texture. A small, sturdy jump ring makes it easy to attach to most fine chains and clasp bracelets. The charm is sold on its own, so you can choose how to style it or combine it with other small keepsakes.

title: Custom Handwriting Circle Pendant
description: Turn a short handwritten word or name into a lasting keepsake with this sterling silver circle pendant. Send a clear image of the handwriting, and it will be engraved onto a 16 mm disc while preserving the original letterforms as closely as possible. The pendant comes on an adjustable 16–18 inch sterling silver chain and is finished with a polished surface. Please provide dark, high-contrast writing on plain paper; one word or a short name works best. Made to order and presented ready for gifting.

title: Fold-Over Leatherette Jewelry Travel Case
description: Keep a small jewelry selection organized on trips with this compact fold-over case, covered in soft, durable leatherette. Inside, a padded ring bar, three necklace hooks with a pocket beneath, and a divided compartment help separate everyday pieces and reduce tangling. The case measures 16 by 11 cm when closed and fastens with a discreet snap. Its slim shape fits easily into a handbag or carry-on, making it useful for weekends away as well as a tidy bedside storage option.

title: Sculpted Rain Cloud Silver Necklace
description: A gently curved cloud pendant is hand-sculpted in sterling silver, with a softly brushed finish that gives the surface a quiet, clouded sheen. Measuring 19 mm wide, it hangs from a fine 18-inch chain with a 2-inch extender for flexible layering. The smooth back rests comfortably against the skin, while the irregular outline keeps the piece from feeling too formal. Wear it as a small everyday reminder to look up, or pair it with other silver chains for a varied neckline.

title: Enamel Poppy Stud Earrings
description: These petite poppy studs combine sterling silver posts with hand-applied red enamel petals and a small dark center. Each flower measures about 9 mm across, giving a cheerful flash of color without overwhelming the ear. The smooth enamel is paired with secure butterfly backs and polished silver settings. Wear them as a bright everyday accent or mix them with simple silver hoops in a second piercing. Because the enamel is applied by hand, slight variations in the petal edges are part of each pair's character.

title: Double-Ridge Sterling Silver Cuff Bracelet
description: Two narrow raised ridges run along this open cuff, adding a tactile detail to a clean sterling silver silhouette. The band is approximately 5 mm wide and is shaped for a gentle, adjustable fit on most wrists; adjust it gradually rather than bending it repeatedly. Its polished edges and softly satin center catch the light without feeling showy. Wear it alone as a simple statement or stack it with a fine chain bracelet. Each cuff is formed and finished in small batches.

title: Engraved Botanical Birth Flower Pendant
description: Choose a birth month and this sterling silver pendant will be engraved with its corresponding flower illustration and month name. The 18 mm round pendant has a lightly brushed face, with the design etched cleanly for a subtle, personal finish. It arrives on an adjustable 16–18 inch silver chain and can be worn close to the collarbone or layered with a longer necklace. Select one birth month when ordering; each pendant is made to order and checked for legibility before it leaves the studio.

title: Honey Citrine Pebble Stud Earrings
description: Warm citrine cabochons sit in low-profile sterling silver settings, making these studs an easy everyday choice with a little color. Each natural stone is approximately 5 mm across, so subtle differences in tone and inclusions are part of the pair. Sterling silver posts and butterfly backs keep them secure for daily wear. The rounded bezels have a smooth edge that feels comfortable against the ear. Supplied as a pair in a cotton jewelry pouch.

title: Contour Solid Gold Signet Ring
description: A compact oval signet gets a softer profile with a shallow, curved top and tapered shoulders. Crafted in solid 14k yellow gold, the 9 by 7 mm face is left plain for a clean, understated finish. The rounded inner band is designed for comfortable daily wear, whether worn alone or alongside slim stacking rings. Available in US sizes 5 through 9. Each ring is made to order and arrives in a recyclable presentation box.

title: Moss Green Silk Cord Bracelet with Silver Toggle
description: A deep moss-green silk cord is finished with a handmade sterling silver toggle and a small polished silver bead. The adjustable sliding knot lets the bracelet fit wrists from 6 to 8 inches, while the lightweight cord makes it comfortable for warm-weather wear and easy layering. Wear it on its own for a quiet touch of color or alongside a silver watch. The cord can be retied if needed; remove before swimming or bathing to help preserve its finish.

title: Tiny Toasted Marshmallow Enamel Charm
description: A small, playful marshmallow charm features creamy ivory enamel with a toasted caramel edge, set on a sterling silver base. Measuring about 12 mm tall, it hangs from a sturdy silver jump ring that fits most fine charm bracelets and necklace chains. The hand-applied enamel gives each piece slight variation in its toasted coloring. Wear it as a lighthearted accent on a chain or add it to a charm collection. Chain sold separately; wipe gently with a soft cloth after wear.

title: Custom Soundwave Silver Pendant
description: Turn a short recorded phrase into a wearable soundwave, engraved across a polished sterling silver bar pendant. The bar measures 32 by 7 mm and hangs from an adjustable 18-inch chain with a 2-inch extender. After ordering, submit a clear audio file up to 10 seconds; the wave is engraved on one side, with an optional short date on the reverse. Each pendant is made to order and arrives ready to give in a recyclable gift box. Please allow two weeks for production.

title: Travel Ring Sizer Gauge
description: A practical sizing tool for checking ring fit at home before choosing a new band. This flexible, reusable plastic gauge has clearly marked US sizes 1 through 13 in half-size increments and fastens with a simple sliding lock. Loop it around a finger, adjust until comfortably snug, and read the size at the marker; checking at different times of day can help account for normal changes in fit. Keep it in a drawer or travel kit for future sizing checks.

title: Brushed Brass and Navy Velvet Jewelry Box
description: A compact tabletop box pairs a brushed brass-finish exterior with a navy velvet-lined interior for everyday jewelry storage. Measuring 6 by 4 by 2 inches, it includes a lift-out tray with ring rolls, two small compartments, and a lower section for chains or bracelets. The hinged lid stays open while you choose what to wear, and the soft lining helps reduce surface scratches. A straightforward storage piece for a dresser or bedside table; wipe the exterior with a dry cloth.

title: Wavy Line Gold Vermeil Hoop Earrings
description: These small hoops bring a gentle sculptural twist to a classic shape, with a softly rippled profile that catches light as you move. Made from recycled sterling silver and finished in 18k gold vermeil, each hoop measures 18 mm across and closes with a hinged snap clasp. The lightweight design works for daytime wear and pairs easily with simple studs in a second piercing. Sold as a pair. Store dry and polish lightly with a soft, non-abrasive cloth.

title: Double Strand Freshwater Pearl Bracelet
description: Two delicate strands of small freshwater pearls create a softly layered bracelet without the weight of a chunky design. The pearls are individually knotted on silk cord and finished with a sterling silver lobster clasp and a short extender chain. Choose a 6.5-inch or 7.5-inch base length for a comfortable fit; natural pearls vary slightly in shape and luster. Wear it with a simple blouse or mix it with a fine chain bracelet. Store flat and avoid contact with perfume or lotions.

title: Jewelry Care Cloth Refill Pack
description: A simple replacement supply for keeping finished silver and gold vermeil pieces looking cared for between wears. This pack contains three soft, untreated cotton cloths, each measuring 6 by 6 inches, suitable for gentle dry buffing of fingerprints and light surface marks. Use a clean section of cloth with light pressure, and keep the cloths dry between uses. They are not impregnated with polish and are not intended to remove heavy tarnish or clean gemstones. A useful drawer staple, rather than a decorative gift.

title: North Star Sterling Silver Compass Necklace
description: A small compass rose hangs from a fine sterling silver cable chain, with crisp engraved lines and a softly polished finish. The pendant measures 14 mm across and the chain adjusts between 16 and 18 inches with a spring-ring clasp. Wear it alone for a subtle everyday detail or layer it with a longer chain. Made in small batches from recycled sterling silver; each necklace arrives in a cotton pouch ready for gifting.

title: Golden Ochre Enamel Hoop Earrings
description: These slim sterling silver hoops are finished with warm ochre enamel along the front edge, adding a restrained pop of color to a classic shape. Each hoop measures 18 mm in diameter and closes with a hinged latch for easy wear. The enamel is applied in small batches, so subtle surface variation is part of the finish. Lightweight enough for daily use, they pair well with simple studs or stand on their own.

title: Hammered Gold Vermeil Signet Ring
description: A softly squared face and hand-hammered texture give this sterling silver signet ring a tactile, modern profile. A thick layer of 18k gold vermeil brings a warm finish without hiding the small irregularities of the surface. The face measures approximately 10 mm across, with a smooth band shaped for comfortable everyday wear. Available in US sizes 5 through 10; choose your usual ring size. Made in small batches and finished by hand.

title: Blue Thread Silver Toggle Bracelet
description: A fine sterling silver chain is paired with a deep blue waxed cotton cord for a casual bracelet with a clean, nautical feel. The small toggle clasp and end bars are solid sterling silver, and the bracelet adjusts to fit wrists from 6 to 7.5 inches. Wear it alone or stack it with a slim metal bangle. The cord is sturdy yet soft against the skin; remove the bracelet before swimming or applying lotions to keep it looking fresh.

title: Tiny Acorn Gold Vermeil Charm
description: A miniature acorn charm is cast in sterling silver and finished with 18k gold vermeil, with a textured cap and smooth rounded base. It measures 11 mm tall and comes with a small jump ring that fits most fine chains and charm bracelets. Wear it as a quiet nod to woodland walks, autumn days, or new beginnings. The charm is sold on its own, so you can pair it with a chain you already own or build a personal collection.

title: Custom Coordinates Bar Necklace
description: Mark a meaningful place with a slim sterling silver bar engraved with your chosen latitude and longitude. The 28 mm pendant hangs from a fine 18-inch cable chain with a 2-inch extender, and is available in polished sterling silver or gold vermeil. Enter coordinates at checkout, using up to two lines of engraving; please check the numbers before submitting. Each necklace is engraved to order in our small studio and arrives in a cotton pouch with a care card.

title: Cedar and Linen Jewelry Box
description: A compact jewelry box made from cedar with a natural satin finish and a removable linen-covered tray. The interior includes six ring slots, two divided compartments, and a lower section for chains or small keepsakes. Measuring 7 by 5 by 3 inches, it fits neatly on a dresser or bedside table. The cedar grain varies from box to box, giving each piece its own character. Wipe the wood with a soft dry cloth and keep the linen insert away from moisture.

title: Garnet Crescent Drop Earrings
description: Deep red garnet briolettes dangle beneath petite crescent shapes in sterling silver, creating an easy movement that catches the light without feeling formal. Each earring measures about 32 mm from ear wire to stone tip and weighs lightly on the ear. The stones are natural, so their color and inclusions may vary slightly. Finished with sterling silver ear wires, this pair works with evening outfits as well as a simple knit and denim.

title: Solid Gold Little Wave Pendant Necklace
description: A gently curved wave pendant is crafted in solid 14k gold, with a smooth, rounded profile inspired by a line drawn in sand. The pendant measures 19 mm wide and hangs from a fine 16-inch chain with a 2-inch extender and a secure spring-ring clasp. Its low-profile shape sits comfortably against the skin and layers easily with other necklaces. Made in small batches; choose yellow or white gold at checkout. Store separately to help prevent scratches.

title: Moss Agate and Silver Stacking Ring
description: A petite oval moss agate cabochon sits in a low bezel on a narrow recycled sterling silver band. Natural green inclusions give each stone a distinct, landscape-like pattern, making every ring slightly different. The stone measures approximately 8 by 6 mm, and the slim band is designed to stack alongside other rings or wear by itself. Available in US sizes 5 through 9. Remove before heavy work, and clean gently with a soft cloth rather than chemical jewelry dips.

title: Tiny Open Book Silver Charm
description: Cast in sterling silver, this miniature open-book charm has lightly etched page lines and a polished edge that catches the light. It measures 13 mm wide and includes a sturdy jump ring for attaching to a bracelet, necklace, or key charm loop. A thoughtful pick for readers, writers, and book-club friends, it is small enough to layer with other keepsakes without adding much weight. Charm is sold individually and arrives in a cotton pouch with a polishing cloth.

title: Tidal Arc Sterling Silver Necklace
description: A gently curved sterling silver pendant hangs from a fine, adjustable chain, bringing a subtle coastal shape to everyday layers. The arc is hand-finished with a softly brushed front and polished edges that catch the light without feeling flashy. Made from recycled 925 sterling silver, the 18-inch chain includes a 2-inch extender and a spring-ring clasp. Wear it alone with an open neckline or pair it with a shorter chain for an easy layered look.

title: Moss Agate Threader Earrings
description: Slim sterling silver threader earrings are finished with small, naturally patterned moss agate drops. Each stone has its own green inclusions and tonal variation, so the pair will not look exactly alike. The fine chains pass through pierced ears and settle at a comfortable length, with polished silver bars at the ends. Made with 925 sterling silver findings, they are lightweight enough for daytime wear and add a quiet touch of color to simple outfits.

title: Oxbow Gold Vermeil Dome Ring
description: A rounded, low-profile dome gives this gold vermeil ring a clean sculptural presence without snagging on sleeves or pockets. The band is formed from recycled sterling silver and finished with a thick layer of 14k gold vermeil for a warm, lasting surface. Its smooth interior is designed for comfortable daily wear, whether worn solo or alongside fine stacking bands. Available in US sizes 5 through 9; remove before swimming or applying lotions to help protect the finish.

title: Little Current Sterling Silver Bracelet
description: A delicate sterling silver chain bracelet features a small, gently rippled centerpiece inspired by water in motion. The 925 silver links are polished by hand and secured with a lobster clasp, with an extender that lets you adjust the fit from 6.5 to 8 inches. It sits lightly at the wrist and works well beside a watch or other slim bracelets. A thoughtful everyday piece for anyone who prefers understated jewelry with a small detail to discover.

title: Tiny Crescent Moon Gold Vermeil Charm
description: This petite crescent moon charm is cut from recycled sterling silver and plated in 14k gold vermeil for a soft golden glow. A small round loop fits most fine chains and charm bracelets, making it easy to add to a necklace you already own. The front is lightly polished while the reverse remains smooth and simple. At approximately 12 mm tall, it makes a subtle celestial accent on its own or alongside other meaningful charms.

title: Engraved Keepsake Locket Necklace
description: A small oval locket in sterling silver opens to hold a tiny photograph, note, or pressed keepsake. The front can be engraved with up to eight characters, making it a personal piece to wear close every day. It comes on an 18-inch 925 sterling silver cable chain with a 2-inch extender and secure lobster clasp. Choose a name, initials, or short date at checkout; the engraving is applied by hand, so slight variations are part of its individual finish.

title: Sea Glass Pebble Stud Earrings
description: These small sterling silver studs pair softly irregular settings with sea-green glass cabochons for an easy, beach-inspired accent. The glass is selected for its translucent color, while the recycled 925 silver settings have a smooth, lightly polished finish. Each stud measures about 7 mm across and fastens with a sterling silver post and butterfly back. Wear them as a subtle pop of color with casual clothes or mix them with other simple silver earrings in multiple piercings.

title: Twisted Olive Branch Silver Charm
description: A slender olive branch is shaped in sterling silver, with tiny raised leaves that give the charm a little texture and dimension. Made from 925 silver, it has a polished finish and a sturdy top loop for threading onto a fine chain or charm bracelet. The charm measures approximately 24 mm from loop to tip. Its botanical silhouette makes a thoughtful addition to a personal collection or a simple nature-themed gift, and it pairs easily with other silver pieces.

title: Pebble Stack Ring Trio
description: Three slim sterling silver bands bring a softly organic look to everyday stacking. Each 925 silver ring has a different hand-textured surface inspired by smooth river pebbles, so the set can be worn together or spaced across several fingers. The bands are lightly rounded inside for a comfortable fit and finished by hand in a small batch. Choose your ring size at checkout; the trio arrives together in a recyclable jewelry pouch, ready to wear or give as a gift.

title: Personalized Petite Bar Bracelet
description: A narrow sterling silver bar bracelet can be engraved with a name, initials, or a short meaningful word. The bar is finished by hand and attached to a fine 925 silver cable chain with a lobster clasp and a 1-inch extender. Select the engraving option at checkout and enter up to ten characters; lettering is kept small to suit the petite surface. With an adjustable fit from 6.5 to 7.5 inches, it is designed for comfortable solo wear or delicate layering.

title: Maple Veneer Jewelry Box with Travel Tray
description: A compact jewelry box keeps everyday pieces organized in a warm maple finish, with a removable tray for rings and small earrings. The wood veneer exterior opens to a soft-lined interior with separate compartments for chains, studs, and keepsakes. Measuring approximately 7 by 5 by 3 inches, it fits neatly on a dresser or inside a suitcase for short trips. A simple lift-off lid and padded base make it a practical home for a small, carefully chosen collection.

title: Rainforest Canopy Gold Vermeil Necklace
description: A delicate sterling silver chain carries a small, openwork canopy pendant, finished in warm 18k gold vermeil. Fine cutout leaves catch the light without adding weight, making this an easy layer for everyday wear or a quiet focal point on its own. The pendant measures 18 mm across, and the adjustable chain fastens at 16 or 18 inches. Made in small batches, it pairs neatly with simple studs and soft, natural textures.
